description: Chabad.org's zmanim, Shabbat and holiday times, and daily Chitas in your terminal, plus a today dashboard, next-zman countdown, and weekly bulletin.

novel_features.name: Today dashboard
novel_features.description: One screen with the Hebrew date, parsha, holiday, today's zmanim with the next one highlighted, the Omer count, and today's Chitas and Rambam.

novel_features.name: Next zman countdown
novel_features.description: The next halachic times and how many minutes until each, rolling into tomorrow's dawn, with an exit-code mode for automation.

novel_features.name: Weekly bulletin block
novel_features.description: A copy-paste weekly block for newsletters and shul signage (--format md|plain, --days N): Shabbat times with week-over-week change, parsha, Hebrew date, Mevarchim and Rosh Chodesh notices, and upcoming holidays, for one or more locations.

novel_features.name: Holiday-season lookahead
novel_features.description: Every fast, erev Yom Tov, Yom Tov end, Rosh Chodesh, Shabbat Mevarchim and first Chanukah candle in the next N days, each with the times it needs (candle lighting, light-from-flame, fast start and end, chametz deadlines); --all adds minor and Chassidic dates.

novel_features.name: Family occasions list
novel_features.description: Keep a local list of family yahrzeits, Hebrew birthdays, anniversaries and bar/bat-mitzvah dates and see which fall in the coming days.
